== Biography ==
Agnes was born in 1810. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-3545]] is assessed at 76% (probable). 'Agnus' Glasgow was baptised on 3 January 1812 at Lloyd Street Presbyterian Chapel, Manchester, a daughter of William and Ann Glasgow; William [[Glasgow-3545]] married Ann Denham at Manchester in 1805 and the same chapel baptised Robert (1806) and William (1816) to William and Ann. Agnes [[Glasgow-3544]], who married David Glasgow at Manchester in 1833 and died there in 1846, fits that baptism by name, place and an approximate 1812-13 birth. The father link rises from 57% to 76% probable.

Index transcripts only; originals uninspected. Ann's surname is not in the baptism, Agnes's 1833 marriage entry does not name her father, and another William and Ann Glasgow in Manchester is not excluded. No mother change follows.
